name: Kotoba
blurb: • Flexible search: Look up words using kanji, kana, rōmaji, or English meaning.
description:
• Flexible search: Look up words using kanji, kana, rōmaji, or English meaning.

• Responsive results: Get matches in a fraction of a second.

• Detailed entries: Readings, meanings, example sentences, and usage notes where available.

• Verb and adjective handling: Automatically recognizes and matches conjugated verb and adjective forms to their base dictionary entry.

• Wildcards: Use * to search by pattern, useful for suffix searches such as *問題.

• Bookmarks: Save entries to revisit later.

• Fully offline: No internet connection required.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
